name: Molecule
definition: A chemical compound in the toxicology dataset, identified by a molecule identifier and, when classified, carrying a carcinogenicity label.
scope: Molecule-level counting, filtering and comparison across the toxicology database.

name: Atom
definition: A single atom belonging to a molecule, identified by an atom identifier and characterized by exactly one chemical element.
scope: Atom-level counting and element composition analysis.

name: Bond
definition: A chemical bond within a molecule, identified by a bond identifier, recording a bond type and connecting two atoms of that molecule.

name: Chemical Element
definition: The chemical element of an atom, recorded as a lowercase chemical symbol. It is the classification dimension used for composition questions.
scope: Atom-level composition questions such as atoms containing hydrogen, or the share of chlorine.

name: Bond Type
definition: The order of a chemical bond, expressed as a one-character symbol denoting a single, double or triple link between two atoms.
scope: Bond-level questions such as single bonds or the most common bond type.

name: Carcinogenicity Label
definition: The toxicity classification assigned to a molecule, recorded as a one-character symbol that distinguishes carcinogenic from non-carcinogenic compounds.
scope: Any question that filters or groups molecules by carcinogenicity.

name: Carcinogenic Molecule
definition: A molecule whose carcinogenicity classification marks it as carcinogenic.
scope: Molecule populations restricted to carcinogenic compounds.

name: Non-Carcinogenic Molecule
definition: A molecule whose carcinogenicity classification marks it as not carcinogenic.
scope: Molecule populations restricted to non-carcinogenic compounds.

name: Single Bond
definition: A bond whose type symbol denotes a single (order-one) covalent link between two atoms.
scope: Question conditions that restrict bonds or molecules to single bonds.

name: Double Bond
definition: A bond whose type symbol denotes a double (order-two) covalent link between two atoms.
scope: Question conditions that restrict bonds to double bonds.

name: Triple Bond
definition: A bond whose type symbol denotes a triple (order-three) covalent link between two atoms.
scope: Question conditions that restrict bonds or molecules to triple bonds.

name: Atom-Bond Adjacency
definition: The connectivity fact stating that a given atom participates in a given bond together with a partner atom. It is the link that relates atoms to the bonds they take part in.
scope: Questions that count bonds per atom, or that need the two atoms connected by a bond.

name: Molecule Reference
definition: The molecule identifier used to attach atoms and bonds to the molecule they belong to. It names the same compounds as the molecule identifier itself, but appears as a referencing value on atom and bond records.
scope: Grounding molecule membership of atoms and bonds, and joining atom/bond facts to molecule classification.

name: Element Occurrence Share
definition: The share of atoms of a specified element within a molecule or within a set of molecules, taken relative to the total number of atoms of that same population.
scope: Composition ratio and percentage questions, such as the ratio of hydrogen in a given molecule.

name: Average Bonds per Atom
definition: The mean number of bonds incident to the atoms of a specified population.
scope: Questions asking how many bonds atoms of a given element have on average.
